items.title: Pairs with locally nilpotent ideal are henselian and etale algebras reduce bijectively
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a pair whose ideal is locally nilpotent, reduction modulo the ideal is an equivalence between the categories of etale algebras, and that the pair is henselian. The proof checks the three requirements for the equivalence: essential surjectivity by lifting etale algebras, fullness by the strong lifting property for smooth algebras, and faithfulness by an idempotent argument using the kernel of the multiplication map and local nilpotence. Henselianity is then verified by showing the ideal lies in the Jacobson radical and lifting factorisations of monic polynomials using the monic lifting lemma together with the equivalence just established.
